text:
Olive Park: hey everyone — Olive here, first day! Remote from ATL today, but flying into SF on Tuesday. excited to be on infra eng. big plant nerd, baker (cardamom rolls ftw), and i have a tiny corgi named quinoa. happy to join any lunchtime dog-photo channels :grin:
Tessa Hu: welcome Olive!! i’m your onboarding buddy — ping me anytime. i’ll DM calendar for a quick 1:1 tomorrow. also coffee or tea? :coffee::tea:
Mark Chen: welcome!! if you’re coming to the office tues, drop by 5B — sunroom desks by the plants. they claim sunscreen is optional but the ficus is demanding. :seedling:
Sanaa Ali: hi Olive!! cardamom rolls??? we need a bake-off. also what laptop did you get? we usually set up VPN and badge on day 1.
Olive Park: thanks Tessa! coffee please :coffee: Laptop is M1 MacBook Air — should i bring power adapter? also, bake-off absolutely. i brought a google doc of 2 recipes already lol.
Facilities Bot: Badge pickup for Olive Park: please bring government ID to 1st floor reception between 9am-5pm. If you're arriving after hours, request a temporary badge via #help with subject `temp badge`.
Kai Nakamura: welcome! tiny corgi photos already mandatory. will post mine later — Olives and dogs = instant friendship. also FYI kitchen has oat milk and a small stash of bagels on fridays.
Tessa Hu: re: adapter — yes please bring it. IT will also have a spare, but their queue can be slow on Mon mornings. I’ll add you to the team Slack channels now.
Mark Chen: quick poll — bagels or croissants for Friday treat table? react with :bagel: for bagel, :croissant: for croissant. (Olive gets veto power if cardamom roll is available) :smile:
Sanaa Ali: also where do you usually park/commute from ATL? we have a couple of folks who can recommend cheap spots near the BART shuttle.
Olive Park: i’ll take the shuttle option tips please — i’m renting a car for the week so parking q’s are relevant. thanks for the warm welcome!!
Tessa Hu: added you to #infra, #daily-standup, and #plant-swaps. also scheduled quick 15m intro with the team tomorrow.
Mark Chen: welcome aboard again — looking forward to your baking contributions. :tada:
Olive Park: yay thank you all! see you in SF Tuesday. posting quinoa pics soon. :dog:
